# awflow

> A deterministic workflow runtime — chain agent calls with journal replay and budget control.

Workflows need deterministic orchestration with journaled execution so every call, every branch decision, and every result can be captured and replayed from any point. Agents running a workflow need to see the same progression whether they are in the middle of a live run or resuming from an earlier checkpoint.

## Install

```
pip install aitherium-awflow
```

## In Claude Code

- skill: `/awflow`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Chain parallel and sequential agent calls with deterministic ordering, a persistent journal, and hard budget enforcement. Replay from the journal at any breakpoint.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awrun](https://aitherium.github.io/awrun/) — A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it -- reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it.
- [awask](https://aitherium.github.io/awask/) — Your agent asks you a question — and acts on your answer.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.
- [awm](https://aitherium.github.io/awm/) — A portable, scoped agent memory.
- [awgraph](https://aitherium.github.io/awgraph/) — A semantic code graph for agents — AST + tree-sitter, call graphs.

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awflow.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
